records.text: Harry Myers said he helped pinpoint the sophisticated cross-border drug tunnel discovered at Douglas, Arizona, in 1990 during Operation Catacomb
records.speaker: Harry Myers

appearances.snippet: In just six days I planted sensors, translated data, and skipped the chain of command and gave proof of the existence and pinpointed the location of the first ever discovered Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms the central event: JTF-6 military geologists used advanced seismic equipment to detect the sophisticated Douglas cross-border tunnel in 1990. The source does not identify Harry Myers, use the name Operation Catacomb, establish a six-day solo discovery, or call it the first-ever Sinaloa rail tunnel. The revised statement presents Myers role as his quoted account and narrows the public fact to what the record supports.

sources.title: $1-Million Drug Tunnel Found at Mexico Border
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous reporting confirms the 1990 Douglas tunnel and says a JTF-6 military geology team using seismic equipment detected it, but does not name Myers or Operation Catacomb.
